data.body: [P1] Restrict owner interruption to fatal cancellation. `stopAllOperations` is also called by ordinary `signalSuspension()`, so this now interrupts child-context owners that are legitimately blocked on durable futures. Their user `finally` blocks run with the interrupt flag set and may fail or perform replayed side effects even though the invocation is only transitioning to PENDING. Keep completion-future wakeups for suspension, but call `interruptRunningUserHandler()` only from fatal/termination paths. Add a parallel/child-context test where multiple branches suspend and verify peers are not interrupted.
